bug_semantics: An authenticated Administration Console user can put an HTML/JavaScript payload such as into a standalone instance's ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT system-property override. standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf includes configuration/systemProperties.jsf, whose overrideVal field accepts the value, and configuration/systemPropertiesButtons.jsf posts row.overrideValue unchanged to the instance system-properties REST endpoint. When another user opens the standalone instance General Information page, the web integration reads every configured network-listener port, resolves ${ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT} against that instance's stored system properties, joins the resolved values into pageSession.httpPorts, and supplies the result to a sun:staticText sink without requesting HTML escaping. The stored markup is therefore emitted into the victim's page and executes in the victim's authenticated browser session.
flaw_origin: The smallest causal change is aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37 in the first-party predecessor repository javaee/glassfish. It added gf.resolveTokens(... endPoint=/servers/server/#{pageSession.instanceName} ...) to v3/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf and changed the displayed list from the unresolved httpPortsList to httpResolvedPortsList. That single change connected per-instance, attacker-controlled system-property substitutions to the already unescaped staticText display. The direct parent displayed only the unresolved listener token strings, so the advisory's ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT payload could not reach this sink there. The later 2018 Eclipse Initial Contribution is an aggregate import, and the 2017 source restructure is only a move; neither is the BIC.

It has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: First-party vulnerability account: https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/vulnerability-reports/-/issues/228 names the authenticated POST endpoint /cluster/standalone/standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf, the overrideVal parameter, the ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT payload , execution when a victim visits General Information, and HTML encoding as remediation; https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/cve-assignment/-/issues/42 identifies the same page and 7.0.15; https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-62g9-99m7-w8wv lists affected versions <=7.0.25 and 'Patched versions None'. Current data flow: appserver/admingui/cluster/src/main/resources/standalone/standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf:40-56 selects the instance system-properties endpoint and includes configuration/systemProperties.jsf; appserver/admingui/common/src/main/resources/configuration/systemProperties.jsf:35-43 and 96-98 load and edit overrideValue; appserver/admingui/common/src/main/resources/configuration/systemPropertiesButtons.jsf:23-26 posts each raw overrideValue. Sink: appserver/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf:25-38 renders pageSession.httpPorts at line 26, reads network-listener ports at lines 29-35, resolves them against the instance at line 37, and joins the resolved list at line 38. Origin mining: git log -L 61,62:appserver/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf in https://github.com/javaee/glassfish traces those two vulnerable lines directly to aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37; -S finds that commit plus only later branch/tag copies and the 168ce449c4ea0826842ab4129e83c4a700750970 source-tree move. The first-party BIC page https://github.com/javaee/glassfish/commit/aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37 shows the exact two-line change. Direct-parent verification: git diff 190039e73f54360fe19821caee14df9c86778660 aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37 shows that v3/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf in the parent converted httpPortsList directly and contained neither gf.resolveTokens nor httpResolvedPortsList; the parent tree is independently visible at https://github.com/javaee/glassfish/blob/190039e73f54360fe19821caee14df9c86778660/v3/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf. Aggregate decomposition: 82ece2ad6f1d70e8c051ab5908b80ffb6ee3801d created the staticText sink, 49896653ff1649f0c1af5a2112785cd47db8a4aa changed it to read the selected instance's config, and aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37 first resolved per-instance system-property tokens into that sink. A content comparison between javaee/glassfish HEAD and Eclipse root import 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb found only license-header differences in serverPageNode.jsf, proving the vulnerable body was carried into the assigned repository. Version boundary: legacy tag 3.0 at 0be8b67ff661266d03a9ece69b1492d80fcd6b69 and 3.0.1 at 51e9c0cee7cb58e7705b7d96d068a6b901886bda have the staticText but not resolveTokens; tag 3.1 at c6960cdb6afc8c0daeadd2377cbd3192b19258ed is the first checked release tree with both vulnerable lines, so the BIC precedes the affected release boundary. Assigned-repository tag trees 7.0.15 at 6f2f4c26b0f825d36b45ef39f6f83ac6b56d438c and 7.0.25 at 17c9f164606e47efbc58907a97ad351a7f54089e both contain the same line-26 sink and line-37 resolver, matching the advisory. Fix search and boundary check: the same lines remain in 7.0.26 at 215b00392179abfef69725ff07455096f2e7fa19, 7.1.0 at 2333b45243ef722b235649526fc99200be8c653d, 7.1.1 at 8e05816bdc1d25b10d4274e0beea417d4ad412cc, 8.0.0 at ca9f02fbdfb5d712d756a320bc8df3847687be96, and audited HEAD 4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567 (source: https://github.com/eclipse-ee4j/glassfish/blob/4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567/appserver/admingui/web/src/main/resources/serverPageNode.jsf). Current-repository --follow history for this file contains only the 2018 aggregate import, and no commit adds escaping or removes the resolver. Thus there is no fix commit, direct fix, or first patched version to record. AI attribution used only git cat-file commit aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37, with the exact marker findings reported in ai_marker.
reasoning: The advisory's payload is stored through the generic instance system-properties form, but accepting arbitrary system-property values is not by itself the XSS origin. The vulnerable lifecycle begins when the General Information integration obtains network-listener port expressions such as ${ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT}, resolves those expressions using the selected instance, and passes the resolved attacker-controlled value to an output component without HTML encoding. Historical decomposition matters because eclipse-ee4j/glassfish begins with the broad 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb Initial Contribution. The recoverable first-party javaee/glassfish history separates the pre-existing display sink (82ece2ad6f1d70e8c051ab5908b80ffb6ee3801d), the instance-config lookup (49896653ff1649f0c1af5a2112785cd47db8a4aa), and the decisive per-instance token resolution (aa41b7dcf394d495b897b8a13fa21b16e51c0c37). The last is the smallest commit that first makes the reported ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT value reach the sink. Its direct parent lacks both newly introduced vulnerable lines, while 3.1 and every checked later release tree contain them. No fixed tree exists: the advisory explicitly lists no patched version, and later release tags plus current HEAD still contain the mechanism. Finally, the BIC commit object is human-authored/committed and has no AI-related identity or trailer, so the BIC-only attribution rule yields NOT_AI despite the absence of a patch.

unpatched.reason: Unpatched as of audited HEAD 4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567: identical vulnerable serverPageNode.jsf source persists in later tags 7.0.26 and 7.1.0 and no commit adds escaping or removes the resolver.

potential_fix.approach: Escape the untrusted resolver output rendered by the Administration Console JSF page, or remove the dynamic resolver interpolation from serverPageNode.jsf.
potential_fix.rationale: Removing or escaping the interpolation closes the console stored-XSS sink; no such change exists in any audited ref.
